note: Both sets hallucinate airfoil entity names not found in the legend (e.g., FFA-W3-1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 210). However, Set B is more accurate on the data values for the actual airfoils listed, correctly identifying Cl=0 at AoA=0 for multiple airfoils and peak Cl/Cd values for FFA-W3-241, 330, and 360. Set A contains significant value errors for the primary airfoil (SNL-FFA-W3-500), claiming a lift-to-drag ratio of 100 when the graph shows ~25, and misreading drag coefficients.
